scripts.dev: npm run build:functions && NODE_ENV=development node scripts/build-static.cjs && concurrently -k "node mock-server.js" "serve dist -l 4173" --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,green"
scripts.dev:watch: npm run build:functions && NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k "node mock-server.js" "node scripts/watch-static.cjs" "serve dist -l 4173" --names "API,BUILD,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green"
scripts.dev:astro: npm run build:functions && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 concurrently -k "node mock-server.js" "astro dev --mode development --port 4173" --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,green"
scripts.build:functions: npm --prefix functions/lead-intake run build && npm --prefix functions/fitbase-schedule run build && npm --prefix functions/fitbase-schedule run build:staging && npm --prefix functions/site-traffic run build && npm --prefix functions/staging-authorizer run build
scripts.import:leads: npm --prefix functions/lead-intake run build && node scripts/import-leads.cjs
scripts.test:build: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/check-routes.cjs --source astro --profile a1 && node scripts/check-build.cjs --profile a1
scripts.deploy:yc: aws s3 sync ./dist "s3://${YC_S3_BUCKET:-zvenfit-frontend}" --exclude "*.html" --exclude "robots.txt" --exclude "sitemap.xml" --exclude "js/*-config.js" --cache-control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" --metadata-directive REPLACE --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --region ru-1 && aws s3 sync ./dist "s3://${YC_S3_BUCKET:-zvenfit-frontend}" --delete --exclude "*" --include "robots.txt" --include "sitemap.xml" --cache-control "no-cache, must-revalidate" --metadata-directive REPLACE --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --region ru-1 && aws s3 sync ./dist "s3://${YC_S3_BUCKET:-zvenfit-frontend}" --delete --exclude "*" --include "js/*-config.js" --cache-control "no-cache, must-revalidate" --metadata-directive REPLACE --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --region ru-1 && aws s3 sync ./dist "s3://${YC_S3_BUCKET:-zvenfit-frontend}" --delete --exclude "*" --include "*.html" --cache-control "no-cache, must-revalidate" --metadata-directive REPLACE --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --region ru-1
